question: The scheme which was launched in March 2016 to free all national highways from Railway level crossings, build bridges and renovate the old bridges on national highways is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is **Setu-Bharatam Project**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Setu-Bharatam Project** was launched in **March 2016** by the Government of India.
 
• The aim of the project is to make all **national highways** free from railway level crossings.
 
• The project includes the construction of new **bridges** and the renovation of old ones on national highways.
 
• The initiative is expected to enhance **road safety** and reduce travel time across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Component
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Objective**
 To eliminate all **railway level crossings** on national highways by constructing **over bridges** and **underpasses**.
 
 

 **Scope**
 Construction of around **208 Railway Over Bridges** (ROBs) and **Railway Under Bridges** (RUBs).
 
 

 **Funding**
 The project is funded by the **Government of India** and executed by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.
 
 

 **Benefits**
 Improves **connectivity** and enhances **road safety** by reducing the risk of accidents at railway crossings.
